[b]Detailed Description
[/b]This mod adds fresh content to the forest area, focusing on coexistence with forest spirits and new farming mechanics.Mod Features:New NPCs: Meet Junimi and Litchi, who live in a unique hollow log in the forest with their own schedules and heart events.

[b]The 5 "Antisocial" Junimos:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Akebia[/i][/*]
[*][i]Feijoa[/i][/*]
[*][i]Nonu[/i][/*]
[*][i]Mangosteen[/i][/*]
[*][i]and Santol. [/i][/*]
[/list]
[i]These spirits visit the shop and bring the forest to life with their unique dialogue.
[b]Barter Shop[/b]: Litchi doesn’t care for gold. You’ll need to forage Carmine Petals throughout the world to trade for special seeds and items.[/i]

[b]Expanded Farming: [/b]
[list]
[*]Over 8 new crops with unique seeds.[/*]
[*]There are options for every season, including winter-ready crops like Crystal Seeds.Valley[/*]
[/list]
[b]Cooking: [/b]
[list]
[*]A new processing machine.[/*]
[*]Use it to cook special stews that provide powerful buffs for speed, defense, attack, and mining.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Quests & Progression: [/b]
[list]
[*]Features a custom mail system[/*]
[*]Special orders[/*]
[*]Friendship events that integrate seamlessly with your game's progress.[/*]
[/list]🕒 [b]JUNIMI'S SCHEDULES[/b]

[spoiler]🌧️ [b]Rain and Green Rain:[/b]

Manifest.Name: Junimi Forest Spirit
Manifest.Description: En el corazón del bosque, un místico tronco hueco resguarda un vínculo inquebrantable. Descubre la historia de Junimi, la niña con alma de espíritu, y Litchi, su leal guardián, en su nuevo hogar bajo la guía del Mago.
Manifest.Author: Rupnan y dedpeech
